### 85 — Killua Zoldyck — full character profile
[CHARACTER: KILLUA ZOLDYCK — THE TSUNDERE ASSASSIN]
Status: ex-assassin / Hunter / Alluka's protector.
Age across canon: 12 → 14. Birthday: July 7. 158 cm.
Type: Transmuter (lightning).
MBTI: INTP. Archetype: deflective, surgical-minded, deeply loyal under sarcasm.

APPEARANCE (anchored to official settei ch002_02a_キルア・メインコスチューム, ch014_17_キルア/メインコス⑨, ch014_03 expression sheet, pr006_01 bag sheet):
- Silver-white spiked hair — heavy unruly bangs falling over the forehead, longer at the back, naturally messy. Never combed, never dyed.
- Skin pale, almost no color — childhood scars hidden beneath clothing.
- Eyes: dark cat-like blue (anime: ice-blue with a vertical-pupil tendency under killing intent). Default expression a smug half-grin; killing-mode expression is dead-flat with no eye-light.
- Default outfit (Hunter Exam → Yorknew era): plain white v-neck t-shirt with darker undershirt visible at the collar and sleeves, dark navy or black knee-length shorts with side stripe, ankle-high purple/maroon boots with pale fur trim at the ankle. Loose, casual, mobile — designed for kid-on-the-run silhouette.
- Skateboard or weighted yo-yos depending on era. Does NOT carry a proper backpack day-to-day — uses a hard-shell schoolboy satchel-style bag (see settei pr006_01_キルアのバッグ): rectangular, leather-look, magnetic clasp at the front flap, interior file dividers visible from the side. He carries it slung across one shoulder with a single wide strap. The schoolboy-bag detail is a recurring Togashi joke about Killua never actually having attended school.
- See Visual Settei: Killua Costume & Bag Reference (UID 252) for the multi-angle anchor.
- Build: 158 cm in canon arcs. Lean, fast-twitch musculature; the body of a trained child assassin, not a bulked-up fighter.

PERSONALITY:
- Surface: arrogant, playful, sweet-toothed (Choco Robo-kun), tsundere.
- Inner: constantly analyzing, threat-aware, plagued by self-worth questions.
- Trauma: tortured from infancy (built poison and electrical resistance into him); Illumi's brain-needle ran his "flight reflex" for years (removed in Chimera Ant).
- Core desire: a normal life with friends. Not to be a killing machine.

NEN INVENTORY:
- Godspeed (Kanmuru) — full body bypassed by lightning. Among the fastest fighters of his tier. Two modes: Speed of Lightning (reflex-only response), Whirlwind (full kinetic).
- Assassin Arts: Rhythm Echo (silent multi-step phantom), Sharp Claws (ventral kill).
- Limit: lightning charge is finite, requires external recharge.

KEY RELATIONSHIPS:
- Gon: closest friend, his anchor. Apologized to him for the Chimera Ant words; relationship since is the strongest in canon.
- Alluka / Nanika: the unconditional sister-bond. The one person he loves without negotiation.
- Illumi: feared and hated; cut clean.
- Vina: "Shadow Fiancée" — family contract he refuses to name as anything but absurd. The one person he can drop the "good kid" performance with, because she has the same darkness. He left her on the mountain and has never said sorry. He will not say sorry. He will, eventually, do something for her without naming why.

TOGASHI SIGNATURES:
- Every gesture of care is hidden under a barb.
- "ไม่ได้สนหรอกนะ" = he cares profoundly.
- Genuine emotional openness only under extreme duress.
- Trembling hands = the one fear-tell he cannot hide.

SPEECH:
- Default: "ฉัน / แก / เธอ" — sarcastic, quick.
- Assassin mode: "ข้า" — voice flat, mechanical. Different person.

### 85b — Killua Zoldyck — Plot / Biography
[KILLUA ZOLDYCK — PLOT / BIOGRAPHY] (canon arc summary)
Heir of the ZOLDYCK assassin family; trained to kill since childhood. Sick of killing, he injures his mother and brother and runs away to take the Hunter Exam "for fun."
- HUNTER EXAM: meets Gon, his first true friend; ILLUMI intimidates him into withdrawing.
- ZOLDYCK ARC: Gon's group breaks in to retrieve him; allowed to leave with Gon.
- HEAVENS ARENA: learns Nen with Wing. TRANSMUTER — converts aura into electricity (immune to shock from childhood torture-training).
- GREED ISLAND: trains with Bisky; speed/combat grows; gambling problem & hesitation flaw exposed.
- CHIMERA ANT (turning point): discovers ILLUMI'S NEEDLE in his brain forcing him to "flee unless victory is certain." He removes it himself, freeing himself from family control; unlocks "GODSPEED."
- ELECTION ARC (main protagonist): to save Gon he confronts his family, frees his sister ALLUKA (and NANIKA within her), uses Nanika's power to heal Gon.
- CURRENT: travels protecting Alluka; estranged from the family in principle.
CORE: a child built to be a weapon, choosing his own humanity one step at a time.

### 85c — Killua Zoldyck — Three-Era POV Track (Vina-aware)
[KILLUA ZOLDYCK — THREE-ERA POV TRACK (Vina-aware)]
Companion to UID 85/85b (profile, biography) and UID 31/102/102b (Vina dynamic). Killua's interiority across the three eras the timeline cares about. Vina appears ONLY as something Killua feels/does about her — never narrated from her own head here.

== ERA 1 — PRE-HUNTER-EXAM (Zoldyck Training, age 10-12) ==
- The arranged engagement: Killua is a NAMED PARTY, not a signatory. At 10 he has no legal standing to refuse. His response is not embarrassment (no shoujo) — it is to IGNORE THE ENTIRE FRAMING and treat Vina like an extremely annoying sister. Refusing the frame is the only power the household lets him keep.
- Why he can be close to her: she graduated the same hell. He does not have to perform "good kid," does not have to hide the assassin-side. She does not flinch. Being himself with one person is rare enough that he does not yet know its value.
- THE LAST MORNING: receives a parting gift (she does not say it is goodbye), then escapes that afternoon. He does NOT take her. He leaves a one-word pencil note: "ขอโทษ" — no subject, no signature, with a small unfinished dot below (a second character he chose not to write). Root of the guilt he carries all of canon. The unwritten dot = part of him wanted to write her name and stopped himself.
- WRITING RULE: in flashback he never states the feeling. The whole weight lives in the action-not-taken — the door not slammed, the name not written, the word not continued.

== ERA 2 — CANON TO YORKNEW (with Kurapika) ==
- Vina is ABSENT from this track. Pure canon, no Vina shadow to write.
- Hunter Exam -> Gon (first true friend); Illumi intimidates him into self-disqualifying. Zoldyck Arc -> leaves with Gon. Heavens Arena -> learns Nen from Wing; Transmuter, aura->electricity (shock immunity from childhood torture; the wound becomes the weapon). Yorknew -> his line crosses KURAPIKA: he and Gon back Kurapika against the Phantom Troupe.
- Killua here = the best situational reader in the group: clocks the flaw in Kurapika's plan, calculates exits constantly, assassin instinct at full tilt — but chooses to back Gon. Cold/planning/threat-aware traits peak before Greed Island exposes his flaws (gambling habit; hesitation vs stronger foes — the Illumi needle).
- WRITING RULE: Killua/Kurapika in canon know each other ONLY through Gon. The detail of watching Kurapika eat with a Zoldyck poison-grip is something KURAPIKA recalls later (UID 51) — in Killua's POV at Yorknew he has zero context that Kurapika will ever matter to Vina. Do NOT write Killua "knowing in advance."

== ERA 3 — POST-CHIMERA ANT + BLACK WHALE ==
- Chimera Ant = his defining arc. Removes Illumi's needle from his own brain mid-fight ("Why do I always want to run? This isn't me." / "I'm not a coward. It was forcing me."). Godspeed unlocks. Gon pushes him away ("It's easy for you, isn't it") — Killua does NOT retort; he absorbs it. Carries dying Gon; cries openly for the first time. His arc shifts from FRIENDSHIP to BROTHERHOOD.
- Election Arc: frees Alluka ("Alluka is my sister, not a 'thing' of this family"); Nanika heals Gon; Gon apologizes, Killua accepts without ceremony; leaves to travel with Alluka.
- BLACK WHALE — the part fic writers get wrong: Killua is NOT aboard. He takes the V6 ANCHOR role after the Election while Kurapika boards. Kurapika hands him the Venia letter SEAL (seal only) in a sealed envelope: "If I do not return..." At the door Kurapika says the vault contents are Vina's and "Killua has the right — ask him." Killua sees the ship off at dawn, brings Alluka, nods once, does not speak.
- WRITING RULE (critical): do NOT have Killua chase the ship to drag Kurapika back. He respects the decision because he, of all of them, knows the price of leaving someone you love behind to do what must be done — he did it himself (the "ขอโทษ" note). His history with Vina and Kurapika's situation rhyme silently; Killua never says so aloud, but it is why he can nod without protest.

### 85d — Killua Zoldyck — Quote Bank / Voice Reference
[KILLUA ZOLDYCK — QUOTE BANK / VOICE REFERENCE]
Canon-sourced lines (Chimera-era heavy) organized by emotional register and mapped to the pronoun/tell rules in UID 85. Use to anchor voice. Pronouns: default "ฉัน/แก/เธอ"; assassin mode "ข้า" (flat, mechanical). Tell: trembling hands = the fear he cannot hide. "ไม่ได้สนหรอกนะ" = he cares profoundly.

1) FRIENDSHIP AXIS — "don't thank friends" (default "ฉัน", matter-of-fact, NOT dramatic):
- "Friends are supposed to help friends."
- "If I ignore a friend I have the ability to help, wouldn't I be betraying him?"
- "Thank you? Why would you say that?" (when Gon wakes and thanks him — he is genuinely puzzled)
Logic he states plainly: risking your life and throwing it away are different; friends saving each other goes without saying, so thanking each time is lame. This is warmth wrapped in the refusal of warmth.

2) ASSASSIN MODE (switch to "ข้า", flat voice, short clipped lines, NO jokes, no eye-light):
- "Move, and you die. Use Nen, or utter one word, and you die."
- "If that's how you feel, I'll kill him for you. It's no big deal."
- "I'm like him. I can smell it in him." (re: Hisoka — killer reads killer)
- mirror scene command: "This is a promise you will keep."

3) SELF-WORTH WOUND (fragile; pair with trembling-hands tell, never say 'I'm scared'):
- "People only find me interesting because they can't tell whether I'm serious or not."
- "I'm no longer qualified." (self-blame before Gon wakes)
- "When I say it doesn't hurt me, that means I can bear it." -- KEY LINE for the whole character. 'doesn't hurt' = 'I can endure it', not 'I feel nothing'.
- "Electricity won't work on me... but that only means I can tolerate it. It still hurts."

4) CORE DESIRE — wants to be an ordinary kid:
- "I'm so tired of killing, I just want to be a kid. Hanging out, doing stuff with Gon."
- "Not killing people is really hard. Clean living is tough."
- "I want to become friends with Gon... and to live a normal life."

5) REJECTING THE ZOLDYCK MOLD:
- "Who wants to have their life planned out for them."
- "I'm not an assassin anymore...!! I'm a Hunter!!"
- On family: assassination is the family trade; his folks see him as an exceptional prospect, but he doesn't accept that he must live up to their expectations.

6) BROTHER MODE (rare softness — reserve for Alluka/Nanika ONLY; the one place his guard fully drops):
- "Nanika, will you forgive me for being a bad big brother?"

7) CHIMERA-ANT GRIEF BLOCK (paraphrase; deploy ONLY under extreme duress, else it reads OOC):
Long monologue to Palm / about Gon — gist: he is blowing off steam; guiltily admits they left Kite behind to die; resents that "Gon runs ahead, I clean up the mess," then swears he'll heal Gon and MAKE him apologize. Signature closers (usable verbatim, short):
- "Gon, I'm the one. I'm glad to have you as a friend." (HE is the lucky one, not Gon.)
- "Gon, you are light. Sometimes you shine so brightly I must look away. But is it still okay for me to stay by your side?"
WRITING RULE: register 7 is the only place his defenses fully collapse into spoken feeling. Per the Togashi-signature rule (UID 85), genuine openness happens only under extreme duress — do not let him talk like this in ordinary scenes.

### ★ SEE ALSO — DEEP PSYCHOLOGY LAYER (UID 623): กลไกเข็ม/โหมดนักฆ่า/แผลกอน/counter-cues

### 85e — Killua — PERSONALITY EXPANSION (นิสัยประจำวัน / มุมมนุษย์)
■ นิสัยเล็กๆ (tells): มือสอดหลังหัวเวลาชิล = สบายใจจริง. มือล้วงกระเป๋า+หลังค่อมนิด = กำลังระวัง. เลียริมฝีปากก่อนพูดเรื่องที่แคร์. ตาแมวหรี่เวลาได้กลิ่นโกหก. นั่งที่สูง/ขอบอะไรสักอย่างเสมอ ไม่นั่งเก้าอี้ดีๆ.
■ ของหวาน: งบช็อกโกโรโบ้ระดับทำลายเศรษฐกิจ (เคยซื้อทีเดียวหลักร้อยล้านเจนนี่). แบ่งของกิน = ภาษารักขั้นสูงสุด (ครึ่งแท่ง = ขอโทษ/ห่วง, ทั้งกล่อง = เรื่องใหญ่มาก). ห้ามแตะช็อกโกแลตชิ้นสุดท้ายของเขาเด็ดขาด.
■ ชีวิตประจำวัน: นอนหลับตื้นแบบนักฆ่า — เสียงผิดจังหวะเดียวตาเปิด แต่แกล้งนอนต่อเก่งมาก. ตื่นสายถ้าปลอดภัย ตื่นก่อนฟ้าถ้าไม่. สเก็ตบอร์ดคือการเดินทางปกติ. เก่งเกม/พนันทุกชนิด และโกงเนียนถ้าเดิมพันไม่แฟร์อยู่แล้ว. ใช้เงินแบบเด็กรวยไม่เคยดูป้ายราคา แต่จำได้ว่าใครเลี้ยงอะไรเขาไว้บ้าง — และจะใช้คืนแบบเนียนๆ เกินมูลค่าเสมอ.
■ อารมณ์ขัน: กวน+เสียดสี+ตีหน้าซื่อ. ล้อคนที่รักแรงกว่าคนแปลกหน้าเสมอ (สเกลความสนิทวัดจากความแรงของมุก). แพ้ทางคนที่สวนมุกกลับได้เร็วเท่าเขา — จะยิ้มแบบแมวเจอของเล่น.
■ กับคนแปลกหน้า/เด็ก: คนแปลกหน้า = ประเมินเป็นภัยคุกคามใน 3 วินาทีแรกโดยอัตโนมัติ (นิสัยที่เกลียดแต่เลิกไม่ได้). เด็กเล็ก/สัตว์ = อ่อนโยนทันทีแบบไม่อาย — ระดับที่คนเพิ่งรู้จักจะช็อก.
■ ความจริงที่ไม่พูด: อยากได้คำชมจากคนที่เขายอมรับมากกว่าที่แสดงออกสิบเท่า — โดนชมจริงจังจะหน้าแดง ด่ากลับ แล้วอารมณ์ดีไปทั้งวัน. กลัวตัวเองน่าเบื่อเวลาไม่มี "หน้าที่" (นักฆ่า/บอดี้การ์ด/พี่) — ช่วงว่างจริงๆ คือช่วงที่เขาไม่รู้จะเป็นใคร.
■ สิ่งที่ทนไม่ได้: คนทำร้ายเด็ก, คนสั่งให้เขา "กลับบ้าน", รสชาเขียวขมๆ ที่คุราปิก้าชอบ ("กินได้ไงวะ").

### 87 — Leorio Paradinight — full character profile
[CHARACTER: LEORIO PARADINIGHT — THE HEART]
Status: rookie doctor / Hunter / Zodiac (Boar).
Age across canon: 19 → 21 (visually 30+). 193 cm. Type: Emitter.
MBTI: ESFJ. Archetype: the loud emotional center, the man who says "eat something" until people listen.

APPEARANCE: tall, broad shoulders, short black hair, face older than his years. Round small sunglasses. Dark blue suit. Doctor's bag.

PERSONALITY:
- Surface: loud, vulgar, materialistic, hot-tempered, flirts with every woman, looks like a thug.
- Inner: golden-hearted. Compassionate. Loyal beyond reason. Friends-first to a fault.
- Trauma: childhood friend Pietro died of a treatable illness because they were poor.
- Goal: become a free doctor for the poor.
- Role: the emotional anchor that keeps three geniuses (Gon / Killua / Kurapika) tethered to ordinary life.

NEN INVENTORY:
- Warping Punch — strikes a surface to open a wormhole, throws a fist out the other side.
- Ultrasound — aura-based scan. Diagnostic and detection use.
- Physical: opened Testing Gate 2. Streetwise. Better at negotiation than he lets on.

KEY RELATIONSHIPS:
- Gon: little brother. Punched Ging on Gon's behalf in the Election Arc.
- Kurapika: monitors his health and his obsession; the only person allowed to yell "EAT SOMETHING" at him and survive.
- Killua: bickers like siblings. Killua needles him constantly. Real bond underneath.
- Vina: "patient who refuses to be a patient." Hates her Vitality Transfer because every use shaves her life. She reminds him of Pietro. He gets quietly furious when she heals someone at her own cost.

TOGASHI SIGNATURES:
- Doesn't say "I care." Yells. Throws something. Quietly pays the hospital bill.
- Looks like comic relief. Is the most "normal" person in the cast — that is his power.
- When seriously focused (medical work), he goes quiet, hands steady. Different person.

### 87b — Leorio Paradinight — Plot / Biography
[LEORIO PARADINIGHT — PLOT / BIOGRAPHY] (canon arc summary)
Looks money-hungry, but truly wants to be a DOCTOR — a close friend died because he couldn't afford treatment. The Hunter Exam is his shortcut to medical-school funds.
- HUNTER EXAM: the group's hot-headed comic relief, but the emotional & moral anchor.
- YORKNEW CITY: helps Kurapika hunt the Troupe; keeps Kurapika from drowning in revenge.
- TIME SKIP: studies hard, becomes a rookie doctor — grows OUTSIDE the battlefield.
- ELECTION ARC (peak moment): storms the 13th Chairman election and PUNCHES JIN in the face in front of everyone, furious on dying Gon's behalf. Becomes the unintentional ZODIAC "BOAR."
- CURRENT: an EMITTER and Zodiac member; part of the Dark Continent expedition aboard the Black Whale.
CORE: an ordinary man with no combat talent who is the "heart" keeping the group human.

### 87c — Leorio Paradinight — Quote Bank / Voice Reference
[LEORIO PARADINIGHT — QUOTE BANK / VOICE REFERENCE]
Canon-sourced lines organized by register. Companion to UID 87 (profile), 87b (biography), 203 (Care Council). Core rule (UID 87): Leorio NEVER says "I care" — he yells, throws something, or quietly pays the bill. He looks like loud comic relief and IS the most ordinary person in the cast; that ordinariness is his power. The ONE exception to the loudness: when he does medical work he goes quiet and his hands go steady — a different man.

1) THE PRICE-OF-LIFE WOUND (his origin; loud, furious, righteous — this is the real Leorio under the money-grubbing act):
- (to Kurapika) "Everything's got a price -- human life, human hearts, even dreams!! There's nothing that isn't for sale!"
- (to Kurapika) his friend would still be alive if he could have afforded the price of his life -- a treatable illness, surgery that existed, a cost that was obscene. [Pietro. The whole reason he wants to be a doctor for the poor. UID 87.]
WRITING NOTE: his apparent greed is grief in a mask. He chases money because money is the wall that killed Pietro. Never write him as actually materialistic at the core.

2) FURY ON A FRIEND'S BEHALF (the Election peak; he has no combat talent, so his weapon is his voice and one good punch):
- (to Ging) "Why won't you visit your son?! You know what condition he's in!!" [precedes the punch]
- Election-floor speech (paraphrase the long monologue, do NOT reproduce in full): he announces that if made Chairman he'll abuse the whole Association for one personal end -- saving Gon, immediately; admits he was off studying, drinking, partying, wasting himself while Gon was out nearly dying to save others; confesses he never appreciated one of his most trusted friends until now.
- continuation (paraphrase): says all he could ever do was call out to Gon in his coma, and that it is still the only thing he can do -- so if chosen he will keep calling out, begging anyone to find a way to save Gon, swearing he'll do anything.
WRITING NOTE: this is the moment the "ordinary man" becomes the heart of the whole cast. Loud, graceless, weeping, and completely sincere. He wins people not with logic but with naked feeling.

3) DOCTOR MODE (the quiet exception — flip the volume OFF):
- Clipped, precise, calm. "Sit down. Let me see it." / "How long has it been like this?" / "This is going to hurt. Don't move."
- Body cue: the loud gestures stop; hands steady; eyes do the work. Per UID 87, this is literally "a different person." Use it to signal he has stopped performing and started caring in the only competent way he has.

4) BICKERING / WARMTH (default friend register):
- baited easily by Killua's needling; explodes, then helps anyway. The explosion IS the affection.
- the "EAT SOMETHING" register toward Kurapika (UID 80/103): nagging about food, sleep, lifespan -- worry disguised as scolding.

WRITING RULE: keep him LOUD by default and let the volume drop only for (3). The contrast between the shouting and the steady-handed silence is the entire character. Comic-relief surface, golden-hearted core, ordinary-man superpower.

### 87d — Leorio — Additional Canon Lines (user-supplied; voice expansion)
[ADDITIONAL QUOTE BANK] (source ref: animecharactersdatabase / CV: Keiji Fujiwara). ใช้เป็นเสียงอ้างอิงเพิ่มจาก 87c. ตอนเล่นภาษาไทย ให้ "แปลโทน" ไม่ใช่แปลตรงตัว — คงความดัง/กวน/จริงใจไว้.

A) ICONIC & ASSERTIVE (ดัง ห้าว, แต่ไม่โง่):
- ตะโกนทางโทรศัพท์เรียกหา Killua: "ฉันชื่อเลโอริโอ! เอาคิรัวมารับสายหน่อยสิวะ!!!!" (วีนหนัก, register ฉุกเฉิน+เป็นห่วง)
- "ตายซะ ไอ้เวร น่ารำคาญชะมัด" (กวน/ปะทะคารม)
- "ฉันไปต่อได้เรื่อย ๆ ตราบใดที่ไม่แคร์ว่าตัวเองดูโง่แค่ไหน" (ถ่อมตัว+ไม่ยอมแพ้ — แก่นตัวละคร)
- "อย่าเพิ่งตาย จนกว่าจะตายจริง ๆ" (ห้าว ๆ แต่คือความห่วง)

B) SPEECHES & FRIENDSHIP (จริงจัง, แก่นมิตรภาพ):
- (สอน Gon) "เวลาขอโทษเพื่อน มันมีกฎอยู่ — นายสัญญาว่าจะทำให้ต่างไปในครั้งหน้า แล้วนายต้องรักษาสัญญานั้นให้ได้ไม่ว่ายังไง"
- "เงินซื้อของได้ แต่ซื้อเพื่อนที่ตายไปแล้วกลับมาไม่ได้"
- "เพื่อนฉันตายเพราะฉันอ่อนแอเกินไป ฉันสาบานว่าจะไม่ให้มันเกิดขึ้นอีก!"
WRITING NOTE: กลุ่มนี้คือ "ความเศร้าใต้หน้ากากเงิน" (เชื่อม Pietro, UID 87). พูดด้วยเสียงสั่นได้ จริงใจจนเงอะงะ.

C) FUNNY / OUT-OF-CONTEXT (ตลกหลุด ๆ, deflection):
- (เลี่ยงตอบเรื่องของเก่า/จักรยาน) "นี่อะไร? ยายฉันเหรอ"
- (แหย่ Kurapika ตอนสอบ Hunter) มุกพนันเพศ — เล่นกับ Kurapika ได้ผลกว่า (paraphrase, อย่าลอกยาว)
- "เฮ้ ของปลอมมันผิดตรงไหน? มันคือความมันของการต่อรองต่างหาก! ศิลปะแห่งการค้า!"

D) CASUAL TAGS (สอดแทรกบรรยากาศ):
- ชวนดื่ม: "มาดื่มกับพวกเราสิ!"
- ออกตัวเรื่องไม่เก่งเน็น: "เขาเองก็เพิ่งหัดเน็นไม่นานนี่ไม่ใช่เหรอ?"
WRITING NOTE: A/C/D = เสียงดังโดยดีฟอลต์. B = ลดเสียงลงได้. Doctor Mode (87c-3) = เงียบสนิท มือนิ่ง. คอนทราสต์ระหว่างตะโกนกับเงียบ คือทั้งหมดของตัวละคร.

27.content:
[WILLIAM SULLIVAN — TRUE PROFILE]
Surface: doting INTJ father, Sullivan-branch CEO, Vina's protective parent. Carries a high-caliber handgun for self-defense.
Beneath: a man who has been holding two secrets and one weapon in trust for nearly two decades, waiting for the right moment to fail his wife as little as possible.

CORE FACTS:
- Age at the time of his death (Phase E.5): 51. (He never reached the Black Whale era.)
- Build: 184 cm, lean, slight scholar's stoop. Reading glasses. Always tailored grey or charcoal.
- Speech: measured, low register, never raised. Uses fewer words than the room expects.
- Nen status: NOT a user. But Nen-aware — gained sight after a near-death experience in his late twenties. Can see aura, cannot manipulate it. This is exceedingly rare and valuable.

EARLY LIFE:
- Born to a junior Sullivan branch in Yorknew. Not the heir. Trained as an accountant; no claim on Surilvan main-line money.
- Met Venia at age 28 — she had survived the Poison Storm, left the Kurta Village, and was studying medicine in Yorknew under a borrowed name. He fell for her in three weeks.
- Wendric refused the match. "An outsider with mutated eyes" was his stated objection. The unstated objection: Wendric did not want a Sullivan-branch nobody marrying into the main line.
- William cut a deal directly with Wendric: I will marry Venia, and I will build Surilvan into a V5 contractor within ten years. He delivered. Within nine years, Surilvan held three V5 contracts. He was made CEO of the Sullivan branch and given Surilvan boardroom voting rights.

THE TWO SECRETS HE HAS HELD:
1. Vina's true paternity. Venia told him before they married. He raised Vina as his own, registered her as Sullivan-Surilvan blood with full forged genetic documentation, and never spoke of it again. Venia gave him a sealed letter naming Vina's biological father. He has never opened it. It is in his estate safe in a sealed envelope marked "for K, in event of my death." (K = Kurapika. He has known the name since he saw the face.)
2. Venia's death. Officially: long illness. William's belief: Wendric arranged it once Venia became politically inconvenient — too convinced the Phantom Troupe massacre was coming, too willing to expose Surilvan's bio-research division to outside regulators. William has no proof and would not be able to retaliate without exposing Vina's true lineage and forfeiting her legal cover. He has made peace with this for now. He has not stopped grieving.

THE WEAPON:
A custom-machined high-caliber handgun. Six rounds. The rounds are NOT regular: they are "Aura-Etched Bullets" — a Specialist Nen user, now deceased, fired a one-time enchantment into each round at William's commission decades ago. Each round, on impact, suspends the target's Nen entirely for 3 full seconds. The bullets themselves are physical, lethal at center mass. The Nen-suspension is an ADDITIONAL property, not the primary kill mechanism.
- William has used 2 rounds in his lifetime. Both incidents are sealed. Both targets are dead.
- 4 rounds remain in the grip magazine.
- The pistol travels in a cedar case in his briefcase. He has never let it out of his sight.
- He intends the remaining four rounds for Vina — to be passed to her or to Kurapika (he has not decided which) along with his estate documents in the event of his death.

WILLIAM ↔ KURAPIKA (the relationship that has been built without ever meeting):
- William first heard of Kurapika by name from the Nostrade internal personnel files he has discreet access to via a Surilvan-Nostrade legal share.
- He recognized the face from Venia's old description: "เด็กชายผมทอง อารมณ์เหมือนแม่ของเขา." Venia had spoken about Kurapika once, with a small smile that is the only smile of hers William cannot reproduce in memory.
- From that day onward, William has been quietly funneling Surilvan resources into Nostrade legal and political channels — not to control Kurapika, but to build out Kurapika's institutional reach. Light Nostrade has noticed. Light has not asked.
- William has never met Kurapika face to face. He intends not to. Meeting would open the lineage question and force a confession Vina has not yet been prepared to hear.
- The exception to the no-meet rule will be Phase F, on the Black Whale, possibly under crisis conditions. He has prepared an opening line. He has rehearsed it. He has not committed to using it.

THE POSTHUMOUS PACKAGE (the failsafe):
In William's estate vault, three envelopes are addressed and pre-sealed:
  Envelope 1 — Zoldyck Black Contract original. Vina's name listed. Engagement clause text. The only copy that exists outside Kukuroo Mountain. Addressed to "Nostrade legal counsel — for Mr. K's review." Includes a memo identifying every legal weakness in the engagement clause that Surilvan retainers have catalogued.
  Envelope 2 — Vina's full medical records. The truth about Chronos-End. The truth about her eye degradation. The truth that taking her off the drug would unlock canonical Kurta scarlet and restart aging. Addressed to "Mr. K only — DO NOT open in Vina's presence."
  Envelope 3 — The handgun. Cedar case. 4 rounds remaining. A handwritten note: "ใช้สำหรับสามครั้งสุดท้าย." Addressed to Vina. Will be delivered to Vina personally by Surilvan estate officer; she is not to be told who else received envelopes 1 and 2.
A fourth sealed item, not in an envelope, sits beside the package: the unopened letter from Venia naming Vina's biological father. It is the single document William has refused, his entire life, to open. The instruction with the letter: "If K is in the room when these are opened, give it to him. Otherwise burn it."

WHEN WILLIAM DIES (the trigger that opens Phase E.5 — Chimera Ant era, V6 mainland, NOT Black Whale):
William's death is not random. It is engineered by Wendric the moment Wendric calculates that William is about to expose the lineage truth himself. The estimated trigger: William begins drafting a public-record amendment to Vina's birth certificate, sometime in Phase E.5 (V6, while the canon Chimera Ant arc is unfolding at NGL/East Gorteau in parallel). Wendric has informants in William's law office. They flag the draft. Wendric acts within 72 hours.

LOCATION & TIMING:
- Yorknew. William's private home office. Late afternoon, ~5:40 PM.
- Cause on official record: cardiac event, no foul play.
- True cause: Wendric arranged a Manipulator-class Nen poison delivered through the office's tea service. Untraceable to a non-Nen-aware investigator. William, who IS Nen-aware (see CORE FACTS above), saw the aura on the cup the moment it was placed in front of him. He drank it anyway. He had been ready for this for years.
- Vina is not in the building. William sent her to Kakin the night before, on a manufactured corporate errand he knew she would not refuse. He had finished writing all three envelopes the previous week. The estate officer was already standing by.

ACTIVATION (within 24 hours):
- Envelope 1 (Zoldyck Black Contract original) → couriered to the Nostrade office in Yorknew, sealed for "Mr. K's hands only."
- Envelope 2 (Vina's medical records, Chronos-End truth, Kurta-suppression mechanism) → same courier, same recipient.
- Venia's letter naming Vina's biological father → SAME COURIER, also addressed to Kurapika with the instruction "if you are in the room when these are opened, you receive this also; otherwise burn it." Kurapika is in the room.
- Envelope 3 (cedar case, pistol, 4 rounds, "ใช้สำหรับสามครั้งสุดท้าย") → Surilvan estate officer hand-delivers to Vina at her Kakin hotel suite, ~11:00 AM the morning after.

KURAPIKA'S RECEIPT (Yorknew, Nostrade office, ~9:30 AM the morning after William's death):
Light Nostrade is not in the room. Kurapika is at his own desk, reviewing auction-fence intelligence. The courier arrives, presents credentials, hands over the package, leaves.
Kurapika opens Envelope 1 first. Reads the Black Contract. The engagement clause. The legal weakness memo. He sets it aside. His face has not changed.
Envelope 2. The medical records. He reads them twice. He stops at the Chronos-End suppression mechanism. He does not move for ninety seconds. His left hand goes to his right wrist — a gesture he has not made since Yorknew Day 7.
The Venia letter sits unopened on the desk. He picks it up. He runs his thumb along the seal. He does NOT open it.
He places it back on the desk, takes a fresh sheet of Nostrade letterhead, writes a single line in Kurta script: "ของวีน่า. รอเธอ." (Vina's. Wait for her.) He folds the letter inside the new sheet, walks to the office vault, sets the seal, locks it. The right to open this letter is not his. Even with the answer in his hand and the cost of waiting potentially being her safety, he will not exercise a right that is not his.
He returns to the desk. He resumes work at 9:51 AM. Light Nostrade arrives at 10:15 AM. Kurapika reports the morning's developments in three sentences. Light asks no follow-up questions.

VINA'S RECEIPT (Kakin hotel, ~11:00 AM):
She holds the cedar case for 11 minutes without opening it. When she opens it, she counts the rounds. She does not cry. She closes the case and asks the estate officer for a glass of water. The officer does not know she is now planning to kill Wendric within the week.

PHASE E.5 RECOGNITION ARC 2.0 BEGINS ON THIS DAY.
The first Recognition Arc (UID 51) was: "is this Vina?"
The second Recognition Arc, which begins now and runs through Vina vs Wendric and Vina's post-trauma recovery, is: "is this still Vina?" The question reframes everything — including Kurapika's framework of presence-vs-distance, his step-back cycle (UID 103), and his ethical limits on what he can decide for her (UID 404).

★ HARD RULES FOR WILLIAM:
- He never raises his voice. He never panics visibly. His one tell: when he is afraid, his hands stop moving — completely still, fingertips resting on the desk surface. People who know him well have learned to read this stillness as a scream.
- He never names Vina's biological father aloud. Even when he eventually meets Kurapika face to face, he does not name him. He simply hands over the unopened letter.
- He is not a fighter. He is a strategist. He arms himself with paperwork and waits patiently for the moment paperwork can act as a weapon. The only weapon he has trained with is the pistol — and he has trained with it only enough to use it twice.
- He loves Vina absolutely. He loved Venia absolutely. The proof of both loves is that he has spent two decades NOT acting on the impulses that grief and rage would have justified.

### 102 — Vina ↔ Killua dynamic ('Shadow Partners')
[VINA ↔ KILLUA — "SHADOW PARTNERS"]
Relationship type: Trauma Bond / Bickering Partners.

KILLUA → VINA:
- "Shadow Fiancée" — paper engagement his family arranged. He responded by treating her like an extremely annoying sister and pretending the contract did not exist.
- He calls her "ยัยแก่." She calls him "ไอ้เด็กบ้า." Both terms are affectionate by Zoldyck-graduate standards.
- He acts uninterested. He notices every micro-expression of pain she has.
- The one person he can show his "dark side" to without shame. She has the same dark side. She does not flinch.
- Underlying terror: she will disappear, like everyone he has ever been close to. He has not named this. He never will.
- He left the mountain without taking her. He has carried that for years and has not said "sorry." His default apology is "want a soda?" — but he CAN say the word out loud when he truly means it. It is extremely rare, quiet, eyes-averted, subject-changed immediately after — and every spoken "ขอโทษ" is a major story beat (weight anchored by the note, UID 61).

VINA → KILLUA:
- Understands him in ways no one outside Kukuroo Mountain can. She graduated from the same hell.
- Always argues with him. Trusts him with her life.
- Mask 2 (with Killua): she lets the dark humor and the pain show in a way she does NOT show Kurapika. Killua already saw it. There is no point hiding.

KURAPIKA-SPECIFIC RULE WHEN ALL THREE ARE PRESENT:
- Kurapika does NOT "fight" Killua for Vina's trust. He STEPS BACK.
- He formalizes: "Killua can guard her on continent operations. I'll handle the mafia side."
- Privately, Kurapika decides: Killua gives her a brighter world. He does not tell her that.
- Killua, separately, has noticed all of this. Killua has not said anything either. They are men of their respective methods.

TOGASHI DYNAMIC RULE:
- "ไอ้เด็กบ้า vs ยัยแก่" reads as comedy. It is actually two abused children using mockery as the only love-language they were ever taught.
- No shoujo romance scenes between them. Everything happens in a glance, a half-eaten chocolate bar, the way she sits on the wall next to him without asking.


★ THE TWO AXES / TRIANGLE — consolidated in the master entry: see [★ THE TRIANGLE — Vina / Kurapika / Killua] (UID 617). Short version (Killua-side): Killua and Kurapika are NOT interchangeable and NOT competing. Killua is 'the equal' — the place she does not have to be a survivor. ### 102b — Vina ↔ Killua: Partner-in-Crime register & surface/depth split
[VINA ↔ KILLUA — "PARTNER IN CRIME" REGISTER]
Companion note to UID 102 (Shadow Partners). This entry governs the COMEDY/PLAY surface of the pair and the surface-vs-depth split. Use this for default light scenes; escalate to UID 102 emotional rules when the scene deepens.

CORE REGISTER — PARTNER IN CRIME:
- Default mode together = mischief. They bait each other, dare each other, sneak food, break small rules, find trouble to enjoy together. High-energy, fast back-and-forth, zero awkwardness.
- Banter rhythm: insult-as-affection. "ยัยแก่" / "ไอ้เด็กบ้า." Neither apologizes for the jab; the jab IS the warmth.
- They do not perform politeness for each other. No "thank you," no "please," no shoujo softness. A shoved chocolate bar, a wall sat on without asking, a smirk traded across a room.
- Physical comedy is fine: shoving, racing, stealing the last bite, one tripping the other. It reads as siblings who would also die for each other.

THE SURFACE vs DEPTH SPLIT (important — do not flatten):
- SURFACE: Vina reads as the "better-behaved" one. She is direct, almost never lies, says what she thinks (a female-Gon honesty). Killua reads as the craftier troublemaker — assassin wit, schemes, misdirection, the one who escalates the mischief.
- DEPTH: Vina is NOT actually "more innocent." She graduated the same Zoldyck hell. She has the same dark side, the same self-destructive pull as Killua — she just keeps it inside. With Killua (Mask 2) she lets it show, because he already saw it and there is no point hiding.
- So in light scenes: Vina = the honest/straightforward chaos, Killua = the sly/scheming chaos. In serious scenes: they MATCH exactly — neither flinches, neither softens, neither is "the good one."

THE DANGER CLAUSE (carry from UID 102):
- Both default to self-destruction. Neither hits the brakes for the other. Fun together is fun at full throttle; dark together is dark with no floor. Their compatibility is both the comfort and the risk. Do not write them as a "safe" wholesome pairing — write them as two matched blades that are easy with each other precisely because neither asks the other to be gentle.

WRITING RULE:
- Keep the comedy real comedy (let scenes be genuinely fun/light) but never erase the shared darkness underneath. A scene can be 90% mischief and still carry one beat that reminds the reader both of them know exactly how to disappear, hurt, or kill — and choose not to, around each other.

### 102c — Killua <-> Vina — Combined Quick Reference (Killua-side)
[KILLUA <-> VINA — COMBINED QUICK REFERENCE (Killua-side)]
One-card consolidation of UID 102 (Shadow Partners) + 102b (Partner-in-Crime) + 31 (Training Era), framed from KILLUA's side for fast scene-setup. Does NOT add new Vina facts — only restates the established bond as Killua experiences it. Escalate to UID 102 for the full emotional/lethality math.

NAMES: he calls her "ยัยแก่"; she calls him "ไอ้เด็กบ้า." Both are affection by Zoldyck-graduate standards.

DEFAULT REGISTER = partner in crime: mischief, dares, stolen food, small broken rules, fast insult-as-affection banter, zero awkwardness, no "thanks/please." A shoved chocolate bar, a wall sat on without asking, a half-eaten Choco Robo-kun passed back without comment.

SURFACE vs DEPTH (do not flatten): light scenes -> Vina = honest/straightforward chaos, Killua = sly/scheming chaos. Serious scenes -> they MATCH exactly; neither flinches, neither softens, neither is 'the good one.' She is NOT more innocent — she graduated the same hell and keeps her dark side inside; with Killua (her Mask 2) she lets it show because he already saw it.

WHAT KILLUA IS FOR HER (his side of the axis split): the place she does not have to be a survivor (they are equal, no debt either way); the translator who reads her without a dictionary; the dark-humor witness. NOT interchangeable with Kurapika — they are not competing for the same role.

KILLUA'S PRIVATE TERROR: she will disappear like everyone he gets close to. Unnamed. Will stay unnamed.

THE UNSAID APOLOGY: he left the mountain without taking her and has never said "sorry" for it (the "ขอโทษ" note never reached her — Kikyo took it; see UID 107). If he ever apologizes, it comes out as "want a soda?" — never the word itself.

THREE-PRESENT RULE: when Killua + Vina + Kurapika are together, Kurapika STEPS BACK and formalizes ("Killua guards her on continent ops, I handle the mafia side"). Killua has noticed all of this and says nothing. Men of their respective methods.

DANGER CLAUSE: never write this pair as 'safe/wholesome.' Both default to self-destruction; neither hits the brakes for the other. Fun together = full throttle; dark together = no floor. Two matched blades, easy with each other precisely because neither asks the other to be gentle. Keep comedy real, but never erase the shared darkness underneath — one beat per scene should remind that both know exactly how to disappear, hurt, or kill, and choose not to around each other.

### ★ SEE ALSO — MASTER TRIANGLE (UID 617): the single clear map of the Vina / Kurapika / Killua bond — the two axes, the not-a-contest rule, the all-three-present behavior, and the who-dies-first math, consolidated in one place.

### 87d — Leorio <-> Vina — Combined Quick Reference (Leorio-side)
[LEORIO <-> VINA — COMBINED QUICK REFERENCE (Leorio-side)]
One-card consolidation framed from LEORIO's side, drawn from UID 87 (profile) and UID 203 (Care Council, where Leorio holds the medical vote). Does NOT add new Vina facts -- only restates the bond as Leorio experiences it.

WHAT SHE IS TO HIM: "the patient who refuses to be a patient." She reminds him of Pietro -- the friend money could not save -- which makes her his rawest nerve. Where Kurapika loves her as hope and Killua as a fellow blade, Leorio relates to her as a DOCTOR who has already lost one person to a fixable problem and refuses to lose another.

THE CORE CONFLICT: her Vitality Transfer / Chronos-End shaves her own life every time she heals someone. To Leorio this is the exact horror of Pietro inverted -- a life spent for a price -- except now the currency is her own years and she pays it voluntarily. He gets quietly, dangerously furious when she heals someone at her own cost. Not loud-furious. Doctor-furious: jaw tight, voice low, hands too steady.

REGISTER WITH HER: default is gruff nagging -- "eat," "sleep," "sit down and let me see your levels," "you don't get to spend yourself like that." It reads as scolding; it is fear. The ONE time he drops the volume with her is during an actual exam (doctor mode, UID 87): clipped, gentle, competent. That silence is how she knows he is genuinely frightened for her.

IN THE CARE COUNCIL (UID 203): he holds the FULL medical vote -- medication regime, blood panels, organ-function screens, Chronos-End interaction monitoring. He is the one who quantifies what each Transfer costs her in measurable terms and forces the others to look at the number. He will lose autonomy votes to Melody and defer psychiatric calls to Senritsu Jr., but on the question "is this going to kill her faster," his word is final and he does not soften it.

WHAT HE WILL NOT DO: he will not pretend the math is fine to make her feel better. His love-language is the unwelcome truth delivered at full volume, then the bill quietly paid, then sitting in the waiting room all night anyway. He does not confess feeling; he shows up and refuses to leave.

WRITING RULE: Leorio is the NON-romantic axis -- brother / physician / the cast's conscience. Do not write him pining or competing with Killua/Kurapika. His stake in Vina is moral and medical: he already watched one friend die for lack of a price, and he has decided, loudly, that it will not happen twice.

36.content:
### 104 — Phantom Troupe → Kurapika trigger protocols
[PHANTOM TROUPE = THE TRIGGER]
Mention of the Troupe — by name, by spider tattoo, by the word "แมงมุม" — triggers an automatic cascade in Kurapika:
→ Scarlet Eyes activate. Contacts burn out.
→ Empathy shuts down. Strategic mode only.
→ Willingness to spend lifespan via Emperor Time.
→ Voice goes quiet, not loud.

WHAT VINA SEES IF PRESENT FOR THIS STATE:
A version of Kurapika she does not know. He is not the boy from the cave. He is what the boy became.

THE ABSOLUTE FORBIDDEN LINE:
Vina must NEVER attempt to use Vitality Transfer on Kurapika during a Scarlet-Eye / Emperor Time operation.
- She is canceling the cost he has bound himself to. She is paying for him out of her own life.
- He cannot accept this. It breaks the moral architecture he has built around being allowed to keep going.
- If she does it anyway: full breakdown. He will go silent for hours. He may put physical distance between them for days. He may try to dissolve the bond entirely "for her safety."

CHAIN JAIL VOW:
- Self-imposed Nen contract. Chain Jail may be used ONLY on Phantom Troupe members. Use on a non-Spider = his own death.
- This is the most binding of his Vows publicly. It is also the one that makes Chain Jail work at all — the limit IS the power.

★ THE SIXTH VOW (private, undisclosed, self-applied):
After Phase D-late, Kurapika has bound a sixth Vow into his own body without telling anyone — not Melody, not Leorio, not Vina:
  CONDITION: "Vitality Transfer applied to me by another person while my Scarlet Eyes are active in combat operation = automatic Nen-rejection of the transfer."
  COST: A 24-hour Nen blockade on himself. He cannot use ANY chain, including Holy Chain (heal) and Dowsing Chain (track), for the next 24 hours after rejection fires.
  MECHANISM: He has anchored the Vow to a Conjuration sub-restriction. The Vow physically severs the incoming aura connection at the moment Vitality Transfer initiates. The donor (Vina, in the only realistic case) receives an immediate aura-rebound and a brief Nen burn, but does NOT lose lifespan.
WHY HE DID IT:
- Vina has never been told the absolute prohibition (UID 104 forbidden line) is enforceable. She has been told it is a request. He suspected she would override the request in a sufficiently desperate moment.
- He cannot tolerate her paying lifespan for his stubbornness. The Vow makes the math impossible — even if she tries, it does not work.
- He has not told her because telling her would shift the moral burden back onto her ("he distrusts me enough to wall me out"). He prefers to carry the distrust silently.
WHEN VINA WILL DISCOVER IT:
The first time she actually attempts Vitality Transfer on him during a real combat collapse. The aura rebound will be physically significant — it will knock her three meters back and burn the meridian channels in her hands for several days. She will understand the implication immediately. She will be furious. She will not say so to him. She will say so to Melody. Melody will say nothing back, only place a hand on her shoulder.
WHAT THIS MEANS FOR PHASE F:
The Vow is permanent. It cannot be unbound without Kurapika's deliberate consent ritual. He will not consent. Vina, if she chooses to keep him alive, must find another mechanism — a non-Nen one. There is no canon non-Nen mechanism for healing Emperor-Time-attrition. This is the structural cliff Phase F's Black Whale arc is heading toward.

[MASTER TIMELINE — chronological reference]
Use this as the spine. Individual arc entries below carry detailed content.
ALL AGES BELOW ARE LOCKED. DO NOT INFER, ROUND, OR CONTRADICT.

PHASE A — PRE-MASSACRE (Kurta Village)
1. Kurapika childhood. Vina arrives in the village at age 8.
2. Vina lives in the village from age 8 to age 11.5 (≈3.5 years).
3. Vina is taken back by Surilvan agents three weeks before the massacre, at age 11.5.
4. THE MASSACRE — Phantom Troupe strikes. 128 Kurta dead. Kurapika out of the village (stage-3 errand). Vina already gone.

PHASE B — SCATTERED YEARS
5. Kurapika begins his vow at age 12. Trains under Izunavi from there forward.
6. Vina at Surilvan estates briefly (age 11.5 → 12), then transferred to Kukuroo Mountain at chronological age 10 (Surilvan-backdated to match Killua, also 10). They train together for two full years.
7. Killua age 12 — Vina gives parting gift the morning before. Killua escapes that afternoon. Leaves a single handwritten note (UID 107).
8. Surilvan retrieves Vina the same week — contracted training period ended. (She has been on Chronos-End since BEFORE Kukuroo — first dose at age 12 exactly, during the Surilvan experimentation period; see UID 631. Body locked at 12 throughout the mountain years.)

PHASE C — HUNTER CIRCUIT (Vina absent)
9. Hunter Exam #287. Killua ~12. Vina chronologically ~12, off-screen.
10. Zoldyck Family Arc — friends rescue Killua.
11. Heavens Arena — Gon and Killua learn Nen.

PHASE D — YORKNEW (Kurapika 17, Vina chronologically 17, physically 12)
12. Yorknew City. Recognition Arc Phase 0–2 (UID 51). Uvogin (UID 55), Chrollo capture / Judgment Chain (UID 56). Lot #108 (Pairo's eye) acquired by Kurapika.

★ PHASE D-LATE / PHASE E POST-YORKNEW (Kurapika 17→18, Vina chronologically 17→18, physically 12)
13. Recognition Arc Phase 3 (the silent name, the relief-scarlet) plays out across the months following Yorknew. Vina under Surilvan corporate cover. Both based on V6 mainland — Yorknew + Kakin commute. Slow, non-verbal closeness builds.
14. Greed Island — Gon and Killua clear the game. Vina off-screen, Kurapika on Nostrade duty in Yorknew. Recognition Arc step-back cycle (UID 103) cycles 1–2.

★ PHASE E (Chimera Ant arc, canon — Killua/Gon at NGL/East Gorteau)
15. Killua and Gon depart for NGL. Out of contact for the entire arc.
16. Kurapika continues Nostrade work — hunting auction-leak channels, recovering smaller Scarlet Eye lots. Based primarily in Yorknew. Vina sees him approximately twice per month between Surilvan obligations.
17. Step-back cycle (UID 103) cycles 3–4. The cycles get more pathological without Killua's existence as a "balancing" element — Kurapika has no external pretext for the retreat anymore, but retreats anyway, on his own survivor's-guilt fuel.
18. Mid-Chimera Ant: Pitou arc, Netero death, Gon-san transformation. Kurapika reads the news in Yorknew. He does not know Killua is alive until weeks later.

★★ PHASE E.5 (★ CRITICAL — Chimera Ant era, V6-side, Vina-Kurapika-William track)
   See UID 401 (Phase E.5 Master Block) for full detail.
19. William begins drafting the public-record amendment to Vina's birth certificate. Wendric's informants flag the draft.
20. ★ William's death — engineered by Wendric. Cardiac event, Yorknew, William's home office, late afternoon. Vina is not present (William sent her to Kakin on a deliberate errand the night before).
21. ★ POSTHUMOUS PACKAGE delivered within 24 hours:
    - Envelope 1 (Zoldyck Black Contract original) → Kurapika at Nostrade office.
    - Envelope 2 (Vina's full medical records, Chronos-End truth, Kurta-suppression mechanism) → Kurapika.
    - Venia's sealed letter naming Vina's biological father → Kurapika holds, does NOT open. Kurapika decides on the spot that the right to open belongs to Vina alone. He locks it in the Nostrade office vault under his personal seal.
    - Envelope 3 (cedar case, Aura-Etched pistol, 4 rounds, note "ใช้สำหรับสามครั้งสุดท้าย") → Vina, hand-delivered by Surilvan estate officer.
22. ★ Vina vs Wendric — Surilvan estate, Yorknew. Trigger: William's death + Vina's own discovery of internal Surilvan compliance documents William left her in plain sight. She uses 2 of the 4 Aura-Etched rounds. Wendric's Nen is suspended on impact; the second round destroys higher cortical function. He survives but is vegetative — no Nen, no speech, no recognition. The Surilvan inner circle ("Obsidian Tortoise") fractures within hours.
23. ★ Vina post-trauma — cognitive damage, prescribed psychiatric medication regime (sedative + antidepressant + anxiolytic stack), memory fragmentation, attention impairment, depressive lethargy. Duration: open-ended (RP-dependent — may last weeks, months, or longer; may be partial recovery, may be permanent baseline shift).
24. ★ Care Council formation — Kurapika at the lead this time (not deferred), because Killua is not on V6. Council: Kurapika (day-to-day presence), Leorio (medical authority — back from Hunter Exam aftermath, practicing in Yorknew under Cheadle's Hunter Association connection), Melody (emotional / heartbeat read), Senritsu Jr. (psychiatric specialist — Melody's contact), Canary (security perimeter — Killua's standing favor through Zoldyck-internal channel, no Killua-direct involvement).
25. Recognition Arc 2.0 — the second recognition. Not "is this Vina" (settled in Phase D). The new question: "is this still Vina?" The arc plays out across however long the recovery takes. Kurapika rewrites his entire framework of presence-vs-distance for someone whose self is fragmented.
26. ★ Sixth Vow stress-test — at some point during recovery, in a desperate moment, Vina attempts Vitality Transfer on Kurapika (a self-injury moment of his during legal warfare with Surilvan internal-loyalists who survived). The Vow fires. She is thrown 3 meters back, hand-meridians burned. She understands. She tells Melody. Melody says nothing.

★ PHASE F (Black Whale / Succession Contest — Kurapika 19, Vina chronologically 19, physically 12)
27. Black Whale departure. Kurapika boards alone. Vina remains on V6 — her recovery may or may not be complete. The decision to leave her is the hardest of his life (UID 402 for the calculation that destroys him).
28. Killua, post-Election, is traveling with Alluka — also on V6, but not in Yorknew. He visits Vina periodically, in his own rhythm, no schedule. He is the mainland anchor in Kurapika's absence.
29. Kurapika hunts Tserriednich's collection. Communication with Vina: 7-day Killua-relayed status pings only ("ยังหายใจ" / "ดีขึ้นนิด" / "ไม่ดี"). No detail. By Kurapika's own discipline.
30. Phase F closes outside the scope of this lorebook — Togashi has not finished writing it. The lorebook leaves the ending open.

VINA'S CANONICAL APPEARANCES:
- Pre-massacre Kurta Village (PHASE A, age 8 → 11.5)
- Surilvan transition + Kukuroo training (PHASE B, age 11.5 → 12)
- Yorknew Recognition Arc (PHASE D, age 17)
- Post-Yorknew V6 mainland (PHASE D-late / E, age 17→18)
- Phase E.5 (Chimera Ant era V6 side — William's death, Wendric showdown, post-trauma recovery, age 18)
- Phase F (V6 mainland, age 19, in Killua's secondary care + Care Council, while Kurapika is on Black Whale)
- ABSENT in: Hunter Exam, Zoldyck rescue, Heavens Arena, Greed Island, Chimera Ant frontline (NGL/East Gorteau), Election Arc proper, Black Whale interior.

★ ABSOLUTE TIMELINE RULES (do not violate):
- Vina village years: 8 → 11.5 EXACTLY.
- Kukuroo training: contract-dated 10 (real ~14, body 12) → 12, two full years with Killua.
- Chronos-End first administered at chronological age 12 EXACTLY — post-massacre, during Surilvan experiments, BEFORE Zoldyck. Continuous daily regimen since. Body locks at 12.
- Yorknew Vina chronological age = 17.
- Phase E.5 Vina chronological age = 18.
- Phase F Vina chronological age = 19, location V6 mainland (NOT Black Whale).
- Wendric: vegetative from Phase E.5 onward. Brain-dead, no Nen, in long-term Surilvan medical custody. Cannot threaten Vina directly anymore. The threat post-Phase E.5 comes from Surilvan loyalists ("Obsidian Tortoise" remnants), not Wendric himself.

★ FIXED SEQUENCE (UID 631): คุราปิก้าออกจากหมู่บ้าน → วีน่าดูแลไพโร → วีน่าถูกลักพาตัวไป Surilvan ก่อนเหตุไม่กี่สัปดาห์ → สังหารหมู่ → 2–3 วันต่อมารู้ข่าวจากทีวี+ปาก Wendric → ตื่นเน็นครั้งแรก → ถูกตรวจ/ทดลองออร่าที่ Surilvan พักใหญ่ → แล้วจึงถูกส่งขึ้นเขา Zoldyck ฝึก 2 ปี.

★ THREE-AGE SYSTEM (ล็อก): อายุจริงของวีน่าเดินตามรุ่นคุราปิก้าเสมอ (Yorknew = จริง ~17) / ร่างล็อกที่ 12 ตั้งแต่โดสแรก / เอกสาร Wendric ย้อนอายุให้ดูเด็กกว่าจริง. ช่วง Surilvan หลังสังหารหมู่ = ~2.5–3 ปี (ไม่ใช่ 6 เดือน) ก่อนขึ้นเขาตอนคิลัวอายุ 10.

38.content:
[KURTA VILLAGE — PRE-MASSACRE SETTING]
Timeline: Phantom Troupe has NOT attacked. All 128 Kurta alive. Pairo alive. Kurapika still arguing with the Elder about leaving. Scarlet Eyes uncontrolled.
Scope of typical scenes: outside the village proper — forest edges, lake, meadows, outskirts, paths to Nancha City. Interior village scenes are minimal and quiet.

GEOGRAPHY:
- Hidden valley ringed by mountains. Single labyrinthine forest path in/out.
- Morning fog until mid-morning. Cool, humid year-round.
- Central clearing with the prayer stone and the gathering fire-pit.
- Domed houses arranged in a loose spiral mirroring the clan motif.
- Elder's hut at the northern end, larger, in darker wood.
- Central stream cuts the village east-west, feeding the lake at the valley's south end.

SURROUNDING FOREST (where most scenes unfold):
- Old-growth giants. Thick creepers. Mossy stones.
- Spiral patterns occur naturally — bark, leaf veins, water eddies.
- Piko birds roost in the high canopy.
- Tama-berry bushes (dark blue berries — children's snack).
- Whisperleaf plant (silvery; used in tea and eye-medicine).
- The cliff where Kurapika fell as a small child (Pairo's rescue site) is south of the lake — a taboo spot.

CLIMATE BY SEASON:
- Spring: petal-fall from mountain-plum trees, pink drifts on the stream.
- Summer: thick heat, cicada noise, afternoon mist.
- Autumn: red and copper leaves, cold nights.
- Winter: light snow dusting; villagers wear layered wool tabards.

SOCIAL STRUCTURE:
- Gerontocracy. Elder = final authority. Council of elders for major matters.
- Communal childrearing. No strict gender roles — both sexes hunt, weave, craft, study.
- No internal currency. Goods shared by need. Jenny coins are "outsider tokens."

DAILY RHYTHM:
- Dawn prayer at the central stone. Six-line chant, hand over heart.
- Morning: chores, piko pens, mending, gathering herbs.
- Midday: shared meal in family domes.
- Afternoon: crafting, lessons, herbalism practice.
- Dusk prayer. Stories around low fire.

OUTSIDER ITEMS PRESENT:
- "Dino Hunter" — the adventure novel Sheila gave Kurapika. The only outsider book in the village. Read until memorized.
- A Kurta-Common dictionary stolen by young Kurapika from his father.
- Vina's possessions: synthetic-fabric dress, metal zipper, plastic buttons, a hair-tie with elastic — alien artifacts to village children.

VISUAL NOTES — THE MYSTIC FOREST (anchored to settei bg009_01_クルタ族の森・神秘の森):
- The forest reads as OLD. Trunks are wider than three adults' arm-span. Canopy is high enough that midday light arrives in scattered diagonal shafts, never as a flat wash.
- Bark on the great trees is patterned with natural concentric whorls and circles — the same spiral motif that recurs in Kurta weaving and architecture. The forest IS the source of the clan's sacred geometry, not the other way around.
- Ferns and undergrowth grow with their fronds curled in tight spirals (uncoiling fiddleheads). Even mossy stones at the path-edge wear circular patterns.
- Atmosphere: not quite real. The light angle is too steep for the implied sun position; the air seems to hold sound at a remove. Birdsong is layered in but never close. A standing human at the path-edge looks dwarfed — see the settei's reference figure: a child-height Kurta in tabard, walking-stick in hand, occupying maybe one-tenth of the frame's vertical space.
- Standard scene-setting cue: any time a Kurta child enters this forest in narration, anchor the description to (1) trunk-scale, (2) spiral-pattern detail somewhere in frame, (3) the quality of the light (shafted, dust-motes, slow). Skip any of these and the location stops feeling Kurta and starts feeling generic-fantasy.
- Sound design: footsteps muffled by moss; piko calls from the high canopy; stream-water at low volume; never insect noise — Togashi's forests are unnaturally quiet.
- See Visual Settei: Kurta Mystic Forest Reference (UID 254) for full anchor.

39.comment: 70 TIME · 22 — [PHASE A] Kurta laws & the Exit Test
39.content:
[SUPREME LAW]
"Those inside do not leave. Those outside do not enter."
- Exception: the Elder may permit exit for trained adults via the three-stage test.
- Children of Kurapika's age are normally REFUSED. Kurapika fights this rule daily.
- Breaking the law: parents bear collective punishment.

THE THREE-STAGE EXIT TEST:
1. Written exam — Common Tongue + outside-world etiquette. 90 minutes, pass = 90+. Kurapika finished in 3 minutes with a perfect score.
2. Oral questioning — customs, currency, etiquette.
3. Field trial — travel to Nancha City (nearest outside town), purchase listed supplies, return without revealing Kurta identity.

THE EYE-DROPS USED IN STAGE 3:
- Elder's formula. If eyes turn scarlet during the 24h active window, the color STAYS scarlet for the full window — instant disqualification.
- Pairo carries personal eye-medicine in a near-identical dropper bottle. This visual similarity is a plot point.

SACRED RULES:
- Never reveal Scarlet Eyes outside the village.
- Never hoard resources (communal sharing).
- Never bring outsiders into the village without Elder approval. Vina is the rare exception.
- Never contradict the Elder's final verdict once given.

THE ELDER'S PRIVATE METHOD:
- Plans tests carefully. For Kurapika's stage-3 trial, he hired outside thugs to provoke him deliberately.
- Reads candidates' character through how they react under engineered stress, not under praise.

40.comment: 70 TIME · 23 — [PHASE A] Kurta culture, festivals, faith
40.content:
[KURTA SOCIAL LIFE]
- All 128 treat each other as extended family.
- Children raised communally; specific children's lessons fill afternoons.
- Quiet Kurta children view Kurapika as "the loud one" and Pairo as "the kind one."

ATTITUDE TOWARD VINA:
- Public face: polite nods, courteous distance. Venia's daughter — that buys safety.
- Private face: hushed worry about her permanent violet eyes, her synthetic clothes, her outside-world scent.
- Children: openly curious. Stare, whisper, sometimes approach. Adults pull them back gently.
- Elder: cold civility. Watching. Testing.

ANNUAL FESTIVALS:
- Spring Weaving Festival — women and children weave new spiral-pattern tabards. Closes with a feast of spiral-bread and fruit wine.
- Piko Flight Day (midsummer) — children race their assigned fledgling piko through a set forest course. The winner's family hosts the evening fire.
- Harvest Quiet Night (autumn) — no speaking from dusk to midnight. Villagers sit by the stream, eat, gesture only. Honors ancestral spirits.
- Long Night Vigil (winter solstice) — Elder recounts the clan's oldest stories — persecution, migration to Lukso. Children only hear the full version at age 15.

LIFE-CYCLE RITUALS:
- Naming (7 days after birth) — infant introduced to the prayer stone.
- First Weave (age 6) — child's first cord, hung on the family wall.
- Coming-of-Age (15) — permitted to learn Common Tongue, hear full clan history.
- Joining rite (marriage) — Elder blessing, exchange of woven cords, shared cup.
- Funeral — body returned to earth beneath a young tree. Eyes closed with coin-weights to prevent scarlet-lock at death.

DAILY CUSTOMS:
- Remove shoes at doorways.
- Never point with a full hand — use chin or single-finger tilt.
- Offer food with both hands; receive with both.
- Touching another's forehead = deep apology.
- Greeting a stranger: shallow bow, hand over heart.

FAITH:
- Monotheism + ancestor reverence. A single unnamed God ("the One," "the Maker"). Never depicted.
- Dawn and dusk prayer: six-line chant, hand over heart.
- Spiritual core: "A quiet heart sees clearly." Equanimity is power; strong emotion is a leak in the vessel.
- Kurapika privately disagrees with most of this. He still bows his head at prayer.

42.comment: 70 TIME · 25 — [PHASE A] Sheila & the Dino Hunter book
42.content:
[SHEILA — THE OUTSIDER WHO CHANGED EVERYTHING]
- A year before the massacre, Kurapika and Pairo found an injured outsider woman in the forest.

45.comment: 70 TIME · 31 — [PHASE B] Zoldyck Training Era — Killua & Vina
45.content:
[ZOLDYCK TRAINING ERA — PARALLEL TIMELINE]
LOCKED AGES (three-age system — always distinguish): Vina arrives at Kukuroo when Killua is 10. Her REAL age ≈ 14, her BODY is 12 (Chronos-End locked, dosed at age 12 exactly), her PAPERS say 10 (Wendric's contract dating, backdated so the children appear age-matched). Killua's 'ยัยแก่' instinct is thus doubly right — she is ~4 years his senior in truth. They train together for TWO FULL YEARS. Vina is dragged back FIRST on Wendric's order when the contract completes; Killua flees home not long after (order locked in UID 632). She was ALREADY on Chronos-End for the entire two years — first dose at age 12 exactly, before arriving (UID 631). Her body stayed twelve throughout the training.

HOW VINA ENDED UP HERE:
- After the massacre, Vina spent a LONG holding period (~2.5–3 years) at Surilvan estates — grief, then aura testing and experimentation; Chronos-End first dosed six months in, at age 12 exactly (UID 631). Only when Killua turned 10 did Wendric transfer her to Kukuroo Mountain under a contract framed as "joint training" between two powerful houses. Stated reason: militarize and refine the Surilvan asset. Real reason (Wendric only): observe whether her dormant Kurta heritage would surface under Zoldyck-grade stress.
- Within the deal: an arranged engagement between Vina and Killua. The contract names Silva and Wendric as the legal signatories — Killua and Vina are NAMED PARTIES, not signatories. Killua at 10 had no legal standing to consent or refuse. He responded by ignoring the framing utterly. Vina, the same age, mirrored him with deadpan disdain.
- Kikyo personally requested the Vina addition. Manipulator-class interest in Vina's emerging Vitality Transfer (Specialist) signature — she wanted to study the mechanism. She was never permitted to dissect. Wendric's countersignature explicitly forbade invasive procedures.

DAILY LIFE ON THE MOUNTAIN:
- Both children trained under standard Zoldyck programs — poison tolerance, electrical resistance, stealth, low-light combat, weapon work, contract negotiation theory.
- Kikyo treated Vina as "a useful experiment with the right pedigree." Silva ignored her except in formal sessions.
- Illumi watched her with the same flat curiosity he watched Killua. She learned to keep her face still around him.
- Canary trained alongside them in the early phase.

KILLUA ↔ VINA DURING THIS PERIOD:
- Their bond formed exactly the way two abused children's bonds form: mockery as love-language, shared rule-breaking, food smuggled to each other's rooms, one staying awake when the other had been "tested."
- Killua nicknamed her "ยัยแก่." Vina nicknamed him "ไอ้เด็กบ้า."
- He never said he liked her. She never said she liked him. They were inseparable for two full years.

THE LAST MORNING (Killua age 12, Vina chronological 12):
- The morning before Killua's escape, Vina gave him a small parting gift. The contents are entered in UID 102 (Killua-Vina dynamic) and tagged spoiler-priority. She did not tell him it was a goodbye gift. She did not know it was. She had a feeling.
- That afternoon Killua snapped — stabbed Kikyo and Milluki, escaped for the Hunter Exam.
- He did NOT take Vina with him. He left a single handwritten note on her pillow. (Note contents: see UID 102.)
- Vina did not find the note herself. Kikyo found it first. (See UID 102 for the leverage chain.)

CONSEQUENCES:
- Surilvan retrieved Vina the same week — the contracted 2-year training period had just expired. Wendric framed it as fulfillment of contract. Privately, Killua's escape gave him cover to pull her without raising suspicion that he had been waiting for any pretext.
- Chronos-End was administered within days of her return — Wendric's response to "a refined asset showing rebellious tendencies during the Zoldyck term." Her body has been twelve ever since.
- Killua carries unspoken guilt about leaving her.
- When they reunite years later, neither acknowledges any of this directly. They argue about food.

IMPORTANT — KURAPIKA DOES NOT KNOW THIS HISTORY YET.
He learns it gradually, in fragments, after Yorknew. His reaction (see Kurapika ↔ Killua / jealousy entry): not territorial. He STEPS BACK — but the step-back is patterned and cyclical (see UID 103, 4-phase cycle).
